summary: Customer wants an optical measurement during yeast fermentation to follow growth and to detect changes earlier, with an undefined 'biomass signal' and 'metabolic signal', and asks for help turning this into an initial feasibility study with reference measurements.

facts_stated.text: The intended application is yeast fermentation.
The purpose is to follow growth.
The purpose is also to notice changes earlier.
Two candidate signals were mentioned by the customer's team: a biomass signal and a metabolic signal.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: both a biomass signal and a metabolic signal

facts_stated.text: Those two signals have not been defined as separate targets.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: these have not been defined as separate targets

facts_stated.text: The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops.

facts_stated.text: The customer wants help turning the request into an initial feasibility study with useful reference measurements.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We need help turning this request into an initial feasibility study with useful reference measurements.

targets.variable: growth (to be followed over the fermentation run)
early detection of changes in the fermentation run
biomass signal (mentioned, not defined as a target)
metabolic signal (mentioned, not defined as a target)

physical_state.enquiry_quote: The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops.

optical_regime.enquiry_quote: The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops.

process.value: broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops
process.enquiry_quote: The broth becomes more optically dense as the run develops.

customer_premises.claim: That a biomass signal and a metabolic signal can be obtained optically and can be separated, even though the customer has not defined them as separate targets.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: Our team has mentioned both a biomass signal and a metabolic signal, but these have not been defined as separate targets.

customer_premises.claim: That an optical measurement will allow them to follow growth and to notice changes earlier.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: to help us follow growth and notice changes earlier

customer_premises.claim: That turning the request into an initial feasibility study with reference measurements is a sufficient and appropriate way forward.
customer_premises.enquiry_quote: We need help turning this request into an initial feasibility study with useful reference measurements.

unknowns: target species and concentration range for the biomass signal
target species and concentration range for the metabolic signal
whether the two requested signals can be separated optically at all
matrix composition and interferents (medium components, dissolved species, particles)
quantitative optical behaviour over the run (scattering vs absorption, path length)
installation point, immersion depth and distance to the spectrometer
required accuracy, detection limit and response time
fermentation scale, vessel type and whether the measurement is in-line or in a bypass
